#### Deciding whether a sample covariance matrix is invertible

A study records $6$ features for each of $4$ people,
and forms the $6 \times 6$ sample covariance [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{S}$
defined in @cor-sample-covariance-singular.

Decide whether $\matr{S}$ is [invertible](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-invertible-matrix).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compare $n$ with $p$.
